Application Data.NAME: Sunny Days Variety Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Days Variety Store offers a diverse selection of household items, apparel, toys, seasonal products, and small electronics. We operate a physical storefront in Springfield, IL, and also have a growing online presence for our products. Our annual sales are projected to be around $450,000, with less than 20% coming from online sales. We prioritize customer service and inventory management, utilizing robust loss prevention measures including security systems and employee training. Our operations do not involve high-risk merchandise, ensuring a stable business model focused on serving the local community effectively.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at Sunny Days Variety Store, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The stolen items included assorted household goods and seasonal merchandise. The claim is currently closed, as proper security measures were in place, but some inventory was not fully accounted for in time, leading to this loss. No other ongoing claims are pending.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Fire Resistant Safe - Model #SRB-1500, capacity 2.5 cu ft, equipped with digital keypad and alarm system.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property and a 24/7 monitored surveillance system with security personnel present during business hours.
